question: Ask HN: Have you used iptables to prevent procrastination?
answer: After reading the comments on today's Disconnecting Distraction essay by PG (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=192654), I realized that I wanted to throttle my internet usage, not relegate it to a few times during the day.  That way, I could still spend some time online, but the "Unable to connect" page would set off alarms.
